name: Derek
secondary_objection: Can you just email me the quote?
trust_unlock: Ask what the competitor included in base preparation, backing and drainage; listen before comparing.
same_day_close_condition: Compare like-for-like installation respectfully, address drainage and total value, present financing, and earn a direct close or agreed next contact.
competitor_quote: Written lower quote uses black-backed turf; base depth and infill are not itemized. Reveal details only when asked.

triggers.line: I already have a cheaper turf quote.
It looks green either way. Why pay more?
Just email me your quote and I will get back to you.

scenarios.title: The cheaper turf quote
scenarios.priority: Avoid replacing a failed yard again.
scenarios.constraint: Competitor quote is $8,400; ambiguous base and infill.
scenarios.opening: You should know I am comparing prices today.

scenarios.title: The drainage question
scenarios.priority: Prevent water pooling near the patio.
scenarios.constraint: Competitor quote is $6,200; drainage scope unspecified.
scenarios.opening: I have a quote already. I am curious what you would do differently.

scenarios.title: The large lawn comparison
scenarios.constraint: Competitor quote is $13,200; disposal and edging unclear.
scenarios.opening: This is a big project, and your competitor says they can do it for less.
